project: Do you want to clear all data?

Guide Santa's sleigh to houses to deliver Christmas gifts. The green arrow indicates where to deliver the next gift. Once over the house the gift is automatically dropped down the chimney. Avoid letting snowmen hit the sleigh as they reduce health. Hitting trees will reduce health to zero!  Earn money by delivering gifts and picking up coins. Get hearts for health and lightning bolts to replenish speed burst capability.

On keyboards use the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to turn the sleigh right or left. Hit the space bar for a speed burst. On touch devices use the on-screen controls for speed burst and turning right and left.

Go to the Garage from the main menu or click the star button on the Gameover box to upgrade the sleigh. Once you max out all of the upgrades your job is done and Santa will be able to go out and deliver gifts worldwide!
